route_ordering_note: In batch.py, the new route POST /api/series/by-name/{label_name}/values must be declared BEFORE POST /api/series/{label_id}/values. This ensures FastAPI matches the literal 'by-name' segment first, preventing ambiguity.
frontend_routing_note: ShellEntry.tsx route <Route path=':label_id' element={<SeriesDetailPage />} /> already matches 'new' as a label_id value. No route changes needed. SeriesDetailPage detects isNew by checking label_id === 'new' at runtime.
